name: refflat
description: The annotation's gene models in refFlat format, the one Picard's CollectRnaSeqMetrics takes as REF_FLAT. Eleven tab-separated columns, no header. DERIVED from the vault's own annotation with UCSC's gtfToGenePred by bin/derive_annotation.sh. The first column is the gene_id, NOT the gene name: Picard groups transcripts into genes by it, and gene names are not unique (Ensembl human has hundreds of genes called Y_RNA), where gene_ids are within one place. A gene_id with transcripts on more than one sequence or strand, which RefSeq annotations have because their gene_id is the gene symbol, is written with its place (ABO@9, ABO@HG2030_PATCH), because Picard skips a gene that is not all on one sequence and strand. The tx2gene asset of the same tag maps each gene_id to its name. The tag is the annotation release, and the annotation asset is recorded as the parent.

required_files.description: the refFlat file written by the DERIVE_ANNOTATION process
